title: Tumbling dipper-shaped lights near Mansfield

tellings.quote: looked up above the trees and I noticed there was this group of stars that looked like the little dipper except they were moving and they were moving in a really strange way.

plain: A man named Jim Weiner says that in spring 1973, near Mansfield State College in Pennsylvania, he looked up above the trees and saw a group of lights shaped like the Little Dipper, a small pattern of stars. He says they were moving, and moving in a really strange way. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast, in an episode about alien abduction, as an early sighting.
